desc: Busy, open-air venue offering cocktails, pub grub & a dance area in a casual atmosphere with a view.
addr: 52, Mahatma Gandhi Rd, Haridevpur, Shanthala Nagar, Ashok Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560001, India

rev.t: I enjoyed my team dinner here, as the food and service were truly outstanding! 🤩 The pizza, ghee roast prawns, andra chilli chicken, and donne biriyani were especially delightful. 🍕🍗 However, the lack of a designated smoking area meant …
Went for a lunch, a group of four and our pet. The staff was really accomodating, even our pet had no struggles throughout the meal. Absolutely loved the experience and the food was amazing as well.

Had a great experience at Sky Deck by Sherlock’s! The food was delicious, the service was really good, and the staff were friendly and attentive. Great ambience and a lovely place to spend an evening. Definitely worth visiting!
